record.t: Joined a group of twenty-two states and the Federal Trade Commission in a lawsuit alleging Amazon overcharged advertising customers by manipulating ad auctions.
record.q: Today, Acting Attorney General Mills joined a  bipartisan group of twenty-two States and the Federal Trade Commission in a  lawsuit against Amazon, alleging that Amazon has systematically and secretly  overcharged its approximately 1.2 million advertising customers by manipulating  the auctions that it uses to set the price of ads on its platform.
